sourceConflicts: The imported ContactPersonDataTypeV3 permits County and Province, but the official read-only PDF and the existing Simpler UI omit both controls for every role. Their XSD presence is not treated as proof that they are applicant-visible questions.

The XSD makes Phone optional inside ContactPersonDataTypeV3, while the DAT requires Phone when any field in that role is entered. The portable applicant schema must preserve the DAT's conditional completeness rule without making the whole role required.

The DAT says State is active and optional on first open, then active and required for USA after Country loses focus and inactive for non-USA. A simple value-based enabled condition does not preserve that initial interaction state; this behavior remains unresolved until the generic runtime can represent it exactly or an intentional delta is reviewed.
The existing Simpler form has no rule schema. It is a rendering and XML compatibility oracle, but it does not prove the DAT's State/ZIP conditional behavior.
